title: Meetings shift by one hour after daylight saving change
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in ScheduleIt, the user encountered: Meetings shift by one hour after daylight saving change.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: Team sync
2. Observe UI state: Timezone: America/Los_Angeles
3. Observe UI state: Team sync

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: Team sync.

## Environment
- App: ScheduleIt
- Platform: web
